detail.longDescription: The “Computational Relativistic Astrophysics" department at the @ mpi_grav in Potsdam announces the opening of postdoc appointments. Each available postdoctoral position will be for a duration of two to three years. ℹ️  https://www. aei.mpg.de/1496849/cra-postdoc -2027 📅 Deadline for full consideration: 13 December 2026. The positions will be available from 1 September 2027. The "Computational Relativistic Astrophysics" department is currently composed of two group leaders (Kenta Kiuchi, Kyohei Kawaguchi), 1 senior scientist (Takami Kuroda), and several postdoc researchers and students, and focuses on several research topics in relativistic astrophysics including – neutron star mergers, – collapsars, – nucleosynthesis, – stellar core collapse and explosion, – formation and evolution of very massive and supermassive black holes, and – multi-messenger astrophysics. # Postdoc # Academia # FediHire # Physics # Research # ScienceJobs # Potsdam
